shared_elements: schematic outline figures rendered as simple linear silhouettes
quadruped animal in profile (deer/horse-like in B; less certain in A)
circular/radiating motif (star-like rosettes in A; whirling swirl disc in B)
scattered small motifs on an open field
justification: Both surfaces carry small, flat, schematic silhouette figures — animals/humans with stick-like limbs — plus a round radiating motif (star-rosettes in A, a whirling swirl disc in B), which gives a loose family resemblance in manner of depiction. But the content differs strongly: A is dominated by manned longboats with crew-stroke rows, a large disc-on-pole object and a figure with a frame, arranged freely over an unbounded rock surface, whereas B shows only two animals above a single large spiral-rayed disc inside a ruled rectangular border, a compositional scheme absent from A.
